name: Pane
summary: Warm off-white product design studio site with a soft serif display, a framed dashboard hero on a fluted-glass gradient and bento cards that show real UI artefacts.

fonts.pairing: Geist Serif 400 with tight negative tracking for display, stats and prices; Satoshi 400 to 500 for body, labels, nav and buttons

signature: product dashboard framed inside a rounded panel of fluted-glass gradient with named multiplayer cursors
bento proof cards that show artefacts (avatars, a month bar chart, a file list, a pull-request checklist) instead of icons
serif numerals for stats and prices set like headlines
process steps as sticky cards each carrying a UI screenshot on a gradient panel
imagery: high-fidelity SaaS UI screenshots (tables, maps, mobile screens) on warm orange-to-lilac fluted glass gradients; one candid portrait for the case study
layout_grid: 1060px content (1200 frame, 70px sides), 112px section padding, centred section headers, 16 to 20px card radius, 1px warm borders, soft layered shadows on cards
